title: Collect receipt imports through iterators
description: An import pipeline changes how paired inputs and parse failures reach the ledger.
commitMessage: Collect ready receipts in a compact iterator pipeline.
reviewContext: The two slices describe one batch: each receipt ID must have exactly one amount. IDs are already valid and unique. Amounts must parse as positive u64 cents. Mismatched lengths or any invalid amount must return Err and leave the ledger unchanged. Empty paired slices are a valid empty import. Only after the complete batch validates may save_import append its receipts.
